parameters.content:
## PlacidWay -> Facebook daily post
Trigger -> robots.txt -> sitemap -> pick 1 new item -> parse page -> LLM draft -> 2 guardrails (rules + LLM review, 1 rewrite) -> approval (optional) -> publish / dry-run -> log.
All config via env (see README). DRY_RUN=true by default.

### Extract (polite)
robots.txt is fetched and honoured every run, Crawl-delay respected, >= 1.1 s between requests, 3 requests per run in total. Sitemap gives lastmod + image without crawling listing pages.

### Generate + guardrails
Rules: length, structure, banned claim words, no prices (unless ALLOW_PRICES), every number must exist in source, every line needs a verbatim source quote.
LLM review: independent pass at temperature 0. Fail -> one rewrite with the issues -> still failing = blocked + alert.

### Failure path
Every risky node has an error output. Classify Failure maps it to a code (SOURCE_BLOCKED, SOURCE_DOWN, FB_TOKEN_EXPIRED, LLM_ERROR, GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED...), logs a failed run, alerts the webhook, then marks the execution failed. Source and LLM HTTP calls retry 3x (5 s apart). Facebook publish calls never auto-retry: a timeout is flagged FB_PUBLISH_UNCERTAIN (check the Page first).
